cohort: The study included 62 newborns diagnosed with birth asphyxia and a control group of 69 term newborns requiring neonatal intensive care for other reasons, all of whom had placental histopathological examinations.
finding: The study found statistically significant associations between umbilical cord abnormalities and hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy, and between microscopic placental lesions (maternal and fetal vascular malperfusion) and hypoxic ischemic syndrome, in newborns with birth asphyxia.
